data.desc: BRC Group Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: RILY) is a diversified holding company with operations across capital markets, wealth management, telecommunications, and consumer retail, alongside strategic investments in equity, debt, and venture capital. Its capital markets and wealth management platform delivers full-service investment banking, M&A and restructuring advisory, equity research, and institutional sales and trading to corporate and institutional clients, as well as comprehensive wealth management, insurance, and tax services to individual investors and families. BRC Group complements these core capabilities with its cash-flow-generative operating subsidiaries and deploys capital opportunistically to drive shareholder value.
